purpose: Original banner lettering extracted and reconstructed as independent transparent artwork for CSS motion. Layout frames compensate for extraction canvas placement; original flat images are retained for comparison.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET, an existing finished advertisement. Extract ONLY the specified existing typography as a transparent PNG overlay. This is NOT a typography redesign: faithfully preserve the source letter shapes, kerning, Portuguese accents, proportions, exact original placement, metal texture, bevels, outlines, highlights and extrusion. Remove everything except the requested text group, its tightly attached shadows and specified text decoration. All other pixels, including the full scene and the other text, must be fully transparent with clean alpha edges. Output the SAME 1983 x 793 wide canvas as the reference. Do NOT crop, recenter, resize or move the requested letters. The large transparent margins are intentional: this overlay will align pixel-for-pixel over the original-sized background. No new typography, no replacement font, no redesigned lettering, no visible checkerboard, no matte fill, no environment, people, characters, props, logos or watermark. Retain an original dark extrusion only when attached tightly to the letters, never a broad background patch. Preserve these exact source letters only:
"INDIQUE. GANHE.".
Extract the silver-white slanted headline at the upper left, about x100–1230, y80–280. Reconstruct only the small portions of its lower strokes hidden behind the foreground 5%, matching the original font. Do not include the 5%, commission label, gold numeric text or bottom text.
